mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_daily_metric(day,scope,subject_id,metric,value,calculated_at) VALUES(#{day},#{scope},#{subject},#{metric},#{value},UTC_TIMESTAMP(3)) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE value=value+VALUES(value)VALUES(value),calculated_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(3)
mapper.select: SELECT day,metric,value FROM t_daily_metric WHERE scope=#{scope} AND subject_id=#{subject} AND day>=DATE_SUB(DATE(DATE_ADD(UTC_TIMESTAMP(),INTERVAL 8 HOUR)),INTERVAL #{value2} DAY) ORDER BY day,metric
